description: Windows footprint of candidate UI stacks for ThinkVision Control. Every window probe shows the same 600x400 window titled 'probe' (label, slider 0-100, toggle switch or checkbox, combo with 3 items, button). Sources: ./<probe>/ next to this file. Method is the same as research_notes/Cross platform monitor control/ui_framework_data.json, so numbers are comparable.

method.size: Sum of every file that ships (exe + DLLs + resources), .pdb excluded. zipped = Compress-Archive -CompressionLevel Optimal of the same files.
method.startup: Stopwatch from Start-Process until a visible top-level window of that PID titled 'probe' (WPF real app: 'ThinkVision Control') at least 100 px wide exists, polled every 10 ms. That replaces Process.MainWindowHandle, which latched onto a 16x16 helper window for winit apps. Run 1 is labelled 'first run'; it is NOT a true cold start (every probe had already been launched once for a screenshot or a smoke test, and no file-cache flush was done). Runs 2-4 are warm. The process is killed between runs.
method.memory: Runs 1 and 2: after 10 s idle, two samples 2 s apart of WorkingSet64, PrivateMemorySize64 and thread count. ws_mb/private_mb are the mean of those 4 samples; threads is the max. Runs 3-4 sample after 3 s (kept in runs[]).
method.dotnet_aot: PublishAot=true, OptimizationPreference=Size, InvariantGlobalization=true (the Win32 and Core probes also use UseSystemResourceKeys=true, StackTraceSupport=false)
method.qt: Release build, MSVC /O1 /GL + /LTCG /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF, dynamic Qt. windeployqt --release --no-translations --no-opengl-sw --no-system-d3d-compiler (QML adds --qmldir). VC++ runtime is not deployed by windeployqt here (loaded from System32; app-local copy would add 1,182,880 bytes).

machine.gpu: AMD Radeon (integrated, driver 31.0.12002.92) + NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (driver 32.0.16.1742), hybrid laptop

toolchains.avalonia: 12.1.3 (+ FluentAvaloniaUI 3.1.0 in the real app; FluentTheme in the minimal probe)

probes.name: ava-real-aot
probes.source: src/ThinkVisionControl.Avalonia at HEAD 8e4fa66 (built from a git-archive copy, repo untouched)
probes.status: builds (exit 0, warnings only); CRASHES AT START
probes.runtime_error: System.InvalidOperationException: Reflection-based serialization has been disabled for this application ... at ThinkVisionControl.Core.Profile.ProfileStore.LoadEmbedded() <- App.OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted(). Exit code 0xC0000409.
aot_trim_warnings: IL3050 Core/Profile/ProfileStore.cs(12/17) static ctor -> new JsonStringEnumConverter()
IL3050 Core/Settings/SettingsStore.cs(10/14) static ctor -> new JsonStringEnumConverter()
ILC IL3050 + 3x IL2070 in Avalonia.Controls.Utils.TypeHelper.GetPropertyOrIndexer (Type.MakeGenericType / GetInterfaces / GetDefaultMembers / GetProperty) - Avalonia's own, reflection binding helper
probes.notes: No warnings from the Avalonia project's own code or FluentAvalonia beyond the TypeHelper ones. Note: the first publish failed at link time only because vswhere.exe was not on PATH (fixed by adding the VS Installer folder to PATH). The exe (23.4 MB) is 9 MB larger than the minimal Avalonia probe's (13.6 MB).

probes.name: ava-real-aot-jsonrefl
probes.command: as ava-real-aot plus -p:JsonSerializerIsReflectionEnabledByDefault=true and a scratch-only Directory.Build.targets adding <TrimmerRootAssembly Include="ThinkVisionControl.Core" />
probes.runtime_error: Without the root: NotSupportedException 'Deserialization of types without a parameterless constructor... ProfileStore+ProfileFile' (ctor trimmed). With Core rooted: NotSupportedException 'System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata.JsonPropertyInfo`1[ThinkVisionControl.Core.Profile.ControlKind] is missing native code or metadata'. Reflection-based STJ cannot be made to work under NativeAOT here without source-generated JsonSerializerContext in Core (a code change, not attempted).

probes.name: ava-min-aot
probes.source: research_notes/Cross platform monitor control/footprint_probe/avalonia (FluentTheme, Mica hint), title changed to 'probe' and a 3rd combo item added
probes.notes: Re-run of the earlier minimal probe with ILCompiler 10.0.14 + OptimizationPreference=Size: 31.6 MB vs 34.8 MB on 2026-10-05 (exe 13.6 MB vs 16.8 MB; Skia/ANGLE/HarfBuzz unchanged). Default rendering = ANGLE on D3D11; the process loaded the NVIDIA GTX 1650 user-mode driver (nvldumdx/nvwgf2umx), i.e. wakes the dGPU on this hybrid laptop. 49-50 threads.

probes.name: wpf-real
probes.command: dotnet publish src/ThinkVisionControl -c Release -o <scratch>/wpf-real (framework-dependent, win-x64, ReadyToRun per csproj)

shared_runtime.download_note: .NET 10 Desktop Runtime installer ~60 MB (not shipped by the app)
shared_runtime.installed_on_disk_bytes_note: Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.0.14 = 76.3 MB + Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App 10.0.14 = 94.4 MB + host 0.4 MB = ~171 MB on disk

probes.notes: Output is file-for-file the same size as the existing build/win-x64 folder. Real app, not the probe window: full Settings UI (NavigationView-style, Mica, dark), and it opens the DDC/CI link to the P32p-20 at start (log shows 'Connected over HDMI'), so memory includes real UI + DDC work and is not directly comparable with the probe windows. A previous (pre-fix) pass using MainWindowHandle gave 1686/991/940/874 ms, WS 158.6 MB, private 82.9 MB.

probes.name: cs-win32-aot
probes.notes: C# NativeAOT + raw Win32 (comctl32 v6 manifest, PerMonitorV2): STATIC, msctls_trackbar32, BUTTON BS_AUTOCHECKBOX, COMBOBOX CBS_DROPDOWNLIST, BUTTON. Single 746 KB exe, no GPU DLLs. Does NOT follow dark mode (classic light controls, grey label/checkbox/trackbar backgrounds on a white window - would need WM_CTLCOLOR* handling and the undocumented dark-mode APIs for a themed look).

probes.name: cs-core-aot
probes.notes: NativeAOT console that references ThinkVisionControl.Core and constructs ProfileStore (loads the embedded profile JSON). Size-only: exe 1,683,968 bytes. It CRASHES at start with InvalidOperationException JsonSerializerIsReflectionDisabled (same root cause as ava-real-aot). AOT warnings for the code reachable from this probe: IL3050 ProfileStore.cs(12) JsonStringEnumConverter; IL2026+IL3050 ProfileStore.cs(73) LoadEmbedded; IL2026+IL3050 ProfileStore.cs(81) LoadOverlay. The full Core warning list is under ava-real-aot.

probes.name: slint
probes.notes: Slint 1.18.1 default features (winit backend; femtovg OpenGL renderer + software renderer + accessibility + system-tray compiled in). Fluent style, follows dark mode and the system accent colour; Switch widget available. Loaded opengl32 + AMD iGPU GL driver (atio6axx), 12 threads. Startup varied between passes: 813/890/779/391 ms in the main pass, 378/336/307/336 ms in a re-run minutes later (runs[] holds the main pass; the re-run is in startup_ms_rerun).

probes.name: slint-sw
probes.notes: slint default-features=false, features [std, compat-1-2, backend-winit, renderer-software]. No GPU DLLs loaded. Looks identical to the GPU build (Fluent dark, accent). No accessibility feature in this variant.

probes.name: egui-glow
probes.notes: eframe 0.37 default-features=false, features [glow, default_fonts]. No toggle switch in egui: a checkbox is used. Follows dark mode (egui's own dark visuals, not Windows-styled). OpenGL on AMD iGPU (atio6axx). Re-run: 247/241/259/228 ms. Needed the 0.37 API change (App::ui(&mut Ui) instead of App::update(ctx)).

probes.name: iced-default
probes.notes: iced 0.14.0 default features (wgpu + tiny-skia fallback, thread-pool, crisp, web-colors, x11/wayland no-ops on Windows). Renders with wgpu: loads Vulkan, D3D12, D3D11 and OpenGL drivers for BOTH GPUs (amdvlk64, nvoglv64, nvldumdx, ...), 47-50 threads, ~264 MB private bytes, ~2.1 s warm startup. Follows dark mode with iced's own palette (purple accent, not the Windows accent).

probes.name: iced-wgpu
probes.notes: iced default-features=false, features [wgpu, thread-pool] (no tiny-skia fallback). Same behaviour as iced-default.

probes.name: iced-tinyskia
probes.notes: iced default-features=false, features [tiny-skia, thread-pool] (an executor feature is mandatory: without it iced fails to compile with 'No futures executor has been enabled'). No GPU DLLs loaded. Visually identical to the wgpu build. 20 threads (thread-pool executor).

probes.name: rust-tray
probes.notes: tray-icon 0.26.1 + global-hotkey 0.9.0: tray icon (16x16 RGBA), 2-item menu (Open/Exit), Ctrl+Alt+M registered, plain GetMessageW loop, no window. Startup not timed (tray-only). Process stayed alive in every run.

probes.name: qt-widgets
probes.notes: Full windeployqt output (adds Qt6Network, Qt6Svg, tls, imageformats, iconengines, generic plugins). Default style on Windows 11 = 'modern windows' style: follows dark mode and the system accent. No toggle switch in Qt Widgets: QCheckBox used. Loads d3d11/d3d12/dxgi/d3d9 (QRhi backing store), 9 threads. probe-qt.exe itself is 35,840 bytes.

probes.name: qt-widgets-min
probes.notes: Hand-pruned minimum that still runs and looks the same: probe-qt.exe, Qt6Core.dll, Qt6Gui.dll, Qt6Widgets.dll, platforms/qwindows.dll, styles/qmodernwindowsstyle.dll. Needs the VC++ 2015-2022 runtime (VCRUNTIME140, VCRUNTIME140_1, MSVCP140, MSVCP140_1, MSVCP140_2 = 1.18 MB) from System32 or app-local.

probes.name: qt-quick
probes.notes: Optional QML/Quick Controls variant (Label, Slider, Switch, ComboBox, Button). windeployqt copies every Quick Controls style (Fluent, Imagine, Material, Universal, Fusion, Basic, Windows) and qmltooling, hence 52.9 MB; a pruned deploy would be smaller but was not attempted. The default Quick Controls style on Windows in 6.8 ('Windows' native style) did NOT follow dark mode: light window in dark mode. D3D11 scene graph, 15-17 threads.
